title: Print Even Numbers in Given Range

content.problemStatement: Print all the even numbers in the given range.

solution.approach: Print all even numbers in range [A, B] separated by space.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Find the first even number >= A, then step by 2 up to B.

hints: If A is odd, start at A + 1.
learningObjectives: Align loop starting point to parity constraints.
